div.head: Wl art 3.1
div.ab: Et si quis de illis occisus fuerit, dominus eius habeat infra quinque dies homicidam eius, si potuerit; sin autem, incipiat persolvere mihi quadraginta sex marcas argenti, quamdiu substantia illius domini perduraverit.

And if any of them is slain, his lord shall arrest the slayer within five days, if he can. If not, however, he shall begin to pay me 46 marks of silver from the property of that lord as long as it lasts out.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 238–239 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text (K–M) not yet added
